baseline_description: A1.1 ea8323a + B1.2 d7e00bd + C1.2 49d48de combo

history.note: First three rounds ran deterministic rules and Mock-only service tests; no live model request was issued. This ledger starts spend from zero.

price_snapshot.peak_hours_utc: Mon-Fri 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00, excluding Chinese public holidays; all other hours off-peak.

task_assumed_rates.discrepancy: Official current Flash cache-miss input is 0.15 off-peak / 0.30 peak; output 0.60 off-peak / 1.20 peak. The assumed 0.14 / 0.28 rates cannot be confirmed against the official page.

alias_status.deepseek_chat_retirement_note: The 2026-04-24 changelog states deepseek-chat / deepseek-reasoner would be retired after 2026-07-24 15:59 UTC; the current pricing and first-call pages do not list deepseek-chat as an accepted name. Routing of deepseek-chat to Flash cannot be confirmed from current docs.

worst_case_reserve.method: Per request: max possible input tokens x input price + planned max output tokens x output price; peak prices used as worst case. Cumulative reserve is recomputed against remaining token and cost budgets before every request.
worst_case_reserve.output_token_budget_binds_first: At 8192 max output tokens, the 60000 output-token cap allows at most 7 requests before the output guard stops the run.
worst_case_reserve.reserve_caveat: The 30-request ceiling is arithmetic only; the output-token guard and any real usage always bind earlier. Fees must be settled from real provider usage; missing usage, uncertain pricing, timeout or unknown status stops the run without retry.

stop_conditions.blocking_reason: Price/alias precheck failed closed; no first request authorized.

redaction: Raw response logs are written only in the isolated round4 directory; Authorization headers and API keys are replaced before serialization. No key fragment is stored in this ledger, reports or git history.
